name: Chill Medicated | 600mg Syrup | Zero Sugar Orange Creme 2:3:1 THC:CBG:THCv
description:
Dosage: 200mg THC : 300mg CBG : 100mg THCv

Activation Time: 5 Minutes - 15 Minutes

120ML | 4 FL OZ

A bright, uplifting blend of sun-ripened oranges and smooth vanilla cream.

The Energy Stack-

A well-balanced blend of THC, CBG, and THCV delivers that feel-good energy you need to kickstart your day without the caffeine crash.

Boosted Energy-

Formulated with energizing THCV, this syrup fuels alertness and motivation to help you get your day in motion.

Focus-

Say goodbye to morning brain fog. The CBG that powers this syrup brings the mental clarity and uplift you need to have a productive, successful day.
